latestVersion.changelog:
Video Online AI — Edit and Export Videos Online, initial release:

- Instantly edit and export video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) with AI-powered cloud rendering
- Simple workflow: upload, describe desired edits (trim, add subtitles, export), and receive edited MP4 in 1–2 minutes
- No software install required; web-based for creators and marketers
- Supports session-based editing, previewing, exporting, and checking credit balances
- Automatic token management for both registered and anonymous users
- Includes error handling, credit system, and support for major video/audio/image file types
